milestones.title: Goal Contract live on NEAR testnet
milestones.result: The goal contract is deployed from the public repo with no access keys, all tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: The goal contract is deployed on NEAR testnet from the public repo.
The goal account has no access keys.
valid_if: The account has no access keys.
Its get_goal returns this spec hash.

milestones.result: A public URL where anyone can see this goal and its milestones read live from chain and connect a NEAR wallet.

It shows this goal and its milestones read live from chain.
Anyone can connect a NEAR wallet.
